pairs.subject: production-trace-scoring
pairs.evidence: src/features/agents/sub_executions/detail/inspector/useTraceData.ts:122 This context only fetches and shows one execution's trace for a person to inspect; it never runs a model judge over live traffic. A case-insensitive rg over every file under src/features/agents/sub_executions/detail (tests included) found no 'judge', 'rubric', 'score' or 'sampl'. The 'settled' and 'verdict' hits are UI loading state and a span-collapse memo, not judging.

techniques.evidence: src/features/agents/sub_executions/detail/ErrorExplanationCard.tsx:46 The failure explanation comes from a fixed classifier (errorPipeline), not from a judge rubric, so there is no rubric here to derive from traces.
